name: Unpatterned-wafer defect inspection equipment series
aliases: 无图形晶圆缺陷检测设备系列
无图形晶圆缺陷检测设备

evidence.excerpt: 无图形晶圆缺陷检测设备系列；主要应用于硅片的出厂品质管控、晶圆的入厂质量控制、半导体制程工艺和设备的污染监控。该系列的设备能够实现无图形晶圆表面的缺陷计数，识别缺陷的类型和空间分布

notes: Series-level identity for SkyVerse's unpatterned-wafer inspection line, the firm's largest single product line by revenue across FY2020-FY2022. SPRUCE-600 and SPRUCE-800 are its named models. The atlas previously held only the patterned series platform. W13 RECORDS REVIEW (accept) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Name/excerpt '无图形晶圆缺陷检测设备系列' confirmed verbatim on skyverse_ipo_2023 p77 (pdftotext without -layout, whitespace-stripped). category_id inspection_unpatterned matches the category definition exactly (unpatterned-wafer defect inspection). reported_maturity 'volume_production' is well supported: skyverse_ipo_2023 pp.168-169 (non-layout, stripped) give actual annual unit sales for this exact series (23/31/47 units across the three reporting years) and state SPRUCE-600 '研发成功并经下游知名客户验证通过后，迅速获得市场广泛认可' -- a real commercial-sales basis, not a catalogue listing. One alias flag: 'SPRUCE' (bare) never appears as a standalone string anywhere in the 345-page prospectus -- every occurrence is SPRUCE-600/-800/-900 (confirmed by a full-document grep). This is a constructed series-label (the common prefix of three real model numbers), not an invented identifier in the SAB8210CWW sense -- no fabricated capability or model number is asserted -- but it should be documented as atlas-constructed rather than left to read as a verbatim issuer term.
